title: How 1.6‑MB Floppy Drives Revolutionized Home Computing

scenes.text: 1.6‑MB floppy was the first affordable PC disk
It held 1.6 megabytes of data, double the 0.8‑MB before
Microsoft shipped the IBM PC with a 5.25‑inch drive in 1981
The 1.6‑MB drive also introduced the first standard for disk formatting
Follow for daily tech and AI news.

description: From 0.8 MB to 1.6 MB, the floppy disk doubled data storage and set the stage for modern file systems. Discover how a tiny drive reshaped the PC world. Follow for more tech history bites!
